source_scope.zero_volume_flat_rows: preserve as observed; source content conflicts with older 5m/15m files and authenticity remains unresolved
source_scope.gap_policy: fail closed; no filling, forward-filling, omission, or synthetic OHLC
source_scope.aggregate_policy: derive 15m bars from complete groups of 15 observed 1m bars; no incomplete-bucket reconstruction
source_scope.funding_timestamp_policy: retain observed calc_time; never snap to nominal settlement time
source_scope.funding_mark_proxy: observed 1h mark-price candle open at exact nominal settlement time; proxy only, not event-time markPrice

signal_spec.indicator_price_series: 15m OHLC; all rolling breakout and ATR inputs use 15m bars

atr.method: Wilder; initial seed is mean of first 14 true ranges; next=(previous*13+TR)/14

relative_strength.rule: candidate symbol 24h close return >= BTCUSDT 24h close return

A_entry.compression_width_atr_reference: previous completed 15m ATR14, excluding current signal bar

B_entry.breakout_reference: same signal as A; freeze prior20 channel and previous completed 15m ATR14 (excluding the breakout signal bar)
B_entry.first_touch: first post-breakout 15m bar whose [low, high] intersects the retest zone
B_entry.confirmation: after the first-touch bar, inspect subsequent bars 1 through 8; confirm on the first completed close > max(high) of the two immediately preceding 15m bars
B_entry.initial_stop: minimum low from first-touch bar through confirmation bar - 0.1*previous_ATR

signal_spec.signal_atr: ATR14 from the previous completed 15m bar, excluding the current signal bar; frozen through setup and position
signal_spec.A_initial_stop: prior20 channel low - 0.1*previous completed 15m ATR14; both values exclude the current signal bar
signal_spec.breakeven_activation: a completed 15m close reaches +1R; move stop to entry for the following bar
signal_spec.trend_baseline: enter next 15m open after hourly filter confirmation; exit next open after filter failure; no stop, target or time exit
signal_spec.buy_hold_baseline: buy equal 1/3 symbol sleeves at each phase start; no adds; hold to forced endpoint exit

phases.name: full
phases.interpretation: full continuous diagnostic window; price-history content quality remains unresolved

phases.name: locked_2025
phases.interpretation: locked diagnostic year; no OOS claim; endpoint open is used for liquidation and its following 15m interval is not simulated

execution_order.funding_at_exact_bar_open: before existing exits and new entries
execution_order.positive_offset_funding: after bar-open entries and before first intrabar barrier; conservative within the selected-window observed 0-16ms offset uncertainty
execution_order.within_minute_barriers: chronological 1m candles; if both stop and target are touched in one minute, use conservative stop-first ordering
execution_order.zero_volume_minute: no fills during zero-volume minutes; an entry whose first 15m minute is zero-volume is canceled; exits due during zero-volume minutes defer to first positive-volume minute; funding events remain charged at observed event times

output_policy: new outputs/vN directory only; fail if target exists; preserve every scenario's equity, events, trades and aggregate metrics
claim_status: EXPLORATORY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; conditional on unresolved source-content conflict; no tradability or out-of-sample claim
